reviewNotes: Twenty-five save, shipping-category, merchant, furniture, construction, blacksmith, and fishing-shop strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placeholders and dynamic word order, character voice and stuttering, gender-neutral player address, established skill and shop terms, punctuation, and concise shop-menu wording; both found no remaining objective issue.

ShippingMenu.cs.11394.preservationReason: Total is spelled identically in Romanian and is the standard accounting label.

ShopMenu.cs.11457.source: Have a look at my wares.
ShopMenu.cs.11457.translation: Aruncă o privire la marfa mea.

ShopMenu.cs.blueboat.source: I specialize in outdoor decorations. Does anything catch your eye?
ShopMenu.cs.blueboat.translation: M-am specializat în decorațiuni pentru exterior. Îți atrage ceva privirea?

ShopMenu.cs.travelernightmarket.source: Surprised to see me? I trade by sea, too! The pig likes a good swim.
ShopMenu.cs.travelernightmarket.translation: Te miră să mă vezi? Fac negoț și pe mare! Porcului îi place să înoate.

ShopMenu.cs.11460.source: Need some construction supplies? Or are you looking to re-decorate?
ShopMenu.cs.11460.translation: Ai nevoie de materiale de construcție? Sau vrei să redecorezi?

ShopMenu.cs.11461.source: I have a rotating selection of hand-made furniture.
ShopMenu.cs.11461.translation: Selecția mea de mobilier lucrat manual se schimbă periodic.

ShopMenu.cs.11462.source: I've got some great furniture for sale.

ShopMenu.cs.11463.source: Got any spare construction material to sell?
ShopMenu.cs.11463.translation: Ai materiale de construcție în plus de vânzare?

ShopMenu.cs.11464.translation: Am {2} {0} care ar arăta chiar {1} în casa ta.

ShopMenu.cs.11469.source: Too lazy to mine your own ore? No problem.
ShopMenu.cs.11469.translation: Prea multă lene ca să-ți extragi minereul? Nicio problemă.

ShopMenu.cs.11470.source: I've got lumps of raw metal for sale. Knock yourself out.
ShopMenu.cs.11470.translation: Am bulgări de metal brut de vânzare. Servește-te.

ShopMenu.cs.11471.source: Looking to sell any metals or minerals?
ShopMenu.cs.11471.translation: Vrei să vinzi metale sau minerale?
